name: Create Non Deliverable Forward Valuation V 02
definition: Scope|The CreateNonDeliverableForwardValuation message is sent by a participant to a central system or to a counterparty to notify the valuation of a non deliverable trade.|Usage|The two trading parties will both send similar notifications to the central settlement system and the central settlement system will send notifications to both.

TradeInformation.name: Trade Information
TradeInformation.definition: Provides identification and date of the valuation of the non deliverable trade which is created.

TradingSideIdentification.name: Trading Side Identification
TradingSideIdentification.definition: Specifies the trading side of the valuation of the non deliverable trade which is created.

CounterpartySideIdentification.name: Counterparty Side Identification
CounterpartySideIdentification.definition: Specifies the counterparty of the valuation of the non deliverable trade which is created.

TradeAmounts.name: Trade Amounts
TradeAmounts.definition: Specifies the amounts of the valuation of the non deliverable trade which is created.

ValuationInformation.name: Valuation Information
ValuationInformation.definition: Specifies the valuation information of the valuation of the non deliverable trade which is created.

ValuationRate.name: Valuation Rate
ValuationRate.definition: Specifies the valuation rate of the valuation of the non deliverable trade which is created.
